rule.flag_when: at each checkpoint, the first that many graded picks in the order their games started: the lower end of the one-sided 99% bootstrap interval of mean per-game log loss is above the baseline. 99% is the one-sided 95% shared equally among the five checkpoints (Bonferroni: 5% / 5 = 1% each). A flag at any checkpoint stands for the season. Since 2026-11-05 a look is held to the mean of its picks' own baselines: baseline for a pick made with the injury report, baseline_no_availability for one made without it.
